legibility_report.target_element: push-button in the compose window toolbar
legibility_report.why_needed_for_user_goal: Clicking the Attach button opens the file chooser so the user can select and attach the AWS bill PDF (~/aws-bill.pdf) to the email draft.
legibility_report.expected_visible_effect_next: A file chooser dialog will appear, allowing navigation to and selection of the aws-bill.pdf file.
legibility_report.what_could_go_wrong: If the coordinates are slightly off or the window moved, the wrong control could be clicked or nothing might happen; the file chooser might not open.
